intellectual_tradition: 公羊学派/汉代儒学/天人感应思想
description_zh: 董仲舒（约前179-前104年），广川（今河北景县）人，西汉思想家、政治家、经学家，被尊为汉代第一大儒。他以《春秋公羊传》为学术根基，系统构建了以天人感应为核心的宇宙论体系，提出三纲五常、大一统、德主刑辅等思想，向汉武帝呈上《天人三策》，建议罢黜百家独尊儒术，奠定了中国封建社会正统意识形态的基础。其著作后世编为《春秋繁露》，开创儒家经学新时代。
description_en: Dong Zhongshu (c. 179-104 BCE), from Guangchuan (modern Jing County, Hebei), was a Western Han dynasty philosopher, politician, and classicist revered as the greatest Confucian scholar of the Han period. Building on the Gongyang Commentary to the Spring and Autumn Annals, he systematically constructed a cosmological framework centered on Tian-Ren resonance (天人感应). He proposed the Three Guides and Five Constants, Great Unity (大一统), virtue-primary punishment-secondary governance, presented the Heavenly Human Three Responses to Emperor Wu, recommended abolishing all schools in favor of Confucianism alone, and laid the foundation for orthodox ideology of Chinese feudal society. His works, compiled posthumously as Springs and Autumns Fanlu, inaugurated a new era of Confucian classicism.
reason_zh: 核心思维：M01(天人相应)、M02(大一统)、M03(德主刑辅)、M04(三纲五常)、M05(灾异谴告)、M06(春秋决狱)、M07(阴阳五行)、M08(三统循环)。董仲舒思维体系以'天-人-政-德-经'五维贯通为特色。五大独特特征：本体宇宙化（将儒家伦理提升至宇宙本体高度）、感应系统论（以阴阳五行构建天人互动网络）、政治神学化（君权神授与灾异谴告的双重约束）、历史循环论（三统循环的历史哲学）、经义司法化（春秋决狱的实质解释方法）。三大创新突破：天人感应系统理论、三纲五常伦理总纲、罢黜百家独尊儒术的制度设计。他是Protreptic中唯一将宇宙论、伦理学、政治学、历史哲学系统整合的思想家。
reason_en: Core thinking modes: M01(Tian-Ren Resonance), M02(Great Unity), M03(Virtue-Primary Governance), M04(Three Guides Five Constants), M05(Disaster Admonition), M06(Spring & Autumn Judicial Interpretation), M07(Yin-Yang Five Elements), M08(Three Dynastic Cycles). Dong Zhongshu's thinking system features five-dimensional integration of 'Tian-Ren-Zheng-De-Jing'. Five unique characteristics: cosmological essentialism (elevating Confucian ethics to cosmic ontology), resonance systems theory (building Tian-Ren interaction networks through Yin-Yang Five Elements), political theology (dual constraint of divine right and disaster admonition), cyclical historical philosophy (Three Dynastic Cycles), classic-law judicialization (substantive interpretation through Spring and Autumn principles). Three breakthrough innovations: systematic Tian-Ren resonance theory, Three Guides Five Constants ethical framework, institutional design of abolishing百家独尊儒术. He is the only thinker in Protreptic who systematically integrated cosmology, ethics, political science, and historical philosophy.
